name: read-method
ground_truth_source: hand-checked: every call-shaped hit in each method body read and decided; per-hit decisions in ground_truth/readmethod.review.md
selection: Written before any method body was read. Candidates: METHOD ... ENDMETHOD blocks in the IMPLEMENTATION section of the global class of a src/**/*.clas.abap file (the main include, not .locals_imp or .testclasses) of at least 1,500 lines, whose METHOD statement is after line 500, whose body (the lines strictly between METHOD and ENDMETHOD) is 30 to 150 lines, not constructor or class_constructor and not a test method. Call-shaped grep over the body, case-insensitive, with full-line comments (*), end-of-line comments (") and '...' / `...` literals removed first (string templates |...| kept, since { } in them can hold calls): the distinct names of '->name(' and '=>name(' (name may be zif_x~m), 'CALL METHOD [receiver->|=>]name', a bare 'name(' followed by a blank, ')' or the line end and not preceded by a word character, '->', '=>', '~' or '/', when name is not in grep_builtins (ABAP built-in functions and constructor operators), and 'NEW x(' or 'CREATE OBJECT' as the name constructor; each name reduced to the part after its last '->', '=>' or '~', as the scorer does. Keep 5 to 30 distinct names. Order the kept candidates by (file path, METHOD line), n of them, k = n div 8, picks at index 0, k, ..., 7k; an index already used or whose file already has 2 picks moves to the next index, wrapping at n. At the pinned commit four files meet the size threshold, so the cap of 2 per file gives 2 picks per file; n = 14 and k = 1. grep_hits / grep_files: whole-word, case-insensitive lines and files under src/ (*.abap) with the bare method name (the part after ~): how hard the right implementation is to find by text. grep_callees: the call-shaped count above. true_callees (distinct names) and true_call_sites: the ground truth. Applied by a script that printed line numbers and counts only. Its first version missed a bare call whose '(' ends the line (only blank or ')' was allowed after it), which left zcl_abapgit_object_tabl_ddl with no candidate and the rule unable to fill eight picks under the per-file cap; the regex was fixed, still before any body was read, and n went from 11 to 14.
